baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-1 day noun and the word-3 reflexive manifestation verb form a temporal event rather than a static description.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded interval opens in light while what was hidden becomes perceptible; the day is both the arriving field of visibility and the participant that comes forth within it.

activation_trace.role: The daylight-opening branch supplies the expanding lit interval and makes it the temporal substrate of disclosure.
The uncovering branch supplies emergence after concealment and makes the predicate an event of disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse names daytime at a moment when it is simply visible.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents daybreak as an active threshold in which a field of visibility opens and the day comes forth within its own opening.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The manifestation verb at word 3 can describe not only appearance but the clearing of a medium or faculty of sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Daylight works like a polishing operation: obscurity is removed from the visual field until forms can be distinguished. Manifestation is thus produced clarity, not merely added brightness.

activation_trace.role: The lit-day branch supplies illumination as the material in which visual distinctions become available.
The polishing-and-sight-clearing branch supplies removal of visual impedance and functions as the mechanism of manifestness.

changed_reading.before: Day appears as a luminous object.
changed_reading.after: Day acts as a clearing operation upon perception, making other things discriminable as it manifests.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The day noun at word 1 carries channel-cutting and widening branches, while the word-3 verb anchors the result in visible emergence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The advance of day can be pictured as a flowing course that cuts and widens a corridor through obscurity. Visibility is spatially made by passage rather than switched on all at once.

activation_trace.role: The river-course branch supplies directed flow that cuts a traversable channel and models daylight's advance.
The widening-until-flow branch supplies spatial expansion and makes openness an effect of passage.
The manifestation branch converts the imagined channel's opening into an observable disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Daylight fills an already available space.
changed_reading.after: Daylight makes its own corridor, cutting and widening a course through what had been visually closed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reflexive word-3 verb permits the day to be construed as presenting itself to a gaze.
baseline_models.mechanism: Manifestation has a social-visual structure: something formerly withheld is displayed, and an observer's gaze rises to meet it. Day is staged presence, not only illumination.

activation_trace.role: The opening day branch supplies the public interval in which presentation can occur.
The ceremonial-display branch supplies a transition from withheld to presented and gives manifestation a social staging.
The searching-gaze branch supplies an implied witness and makes visibility relational rather than purely physical.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an impersonal astronomical transition.
changed_reading.after: The day presents itself in a scene of display and regard, making manifestation an encounter between appearance and gaze.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-3 manifestation root includes departure and expulsion, while the word-1 day root includes opening and enlargement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day becomes manifest by making room: its expansion dislodges what occupied the visual field. Disclosure is simultaneously arrival and evacuation.

activation_trace.role: The opening-and-widening branch supplies the production of room in which the day can spread.
The departure-and-expulsion branch supplies displacement and makes clearance the underside of manifestation.

changed_reading.before: Manifestation adds a visible presence.
changed_reading.after: Manifestation is a replacement event: day spreads by clearing another occupancy from the field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding covering scene supplies the negative operation that the focus reverses. Day's manifestation now reads as a countermotion that peels back a comprehensive cover rather than as an isolated sunrise.

activation_trace.role: The opening-day branch supplies the positive expansion that answers the prior contraction of visibility.
The uncovering branch supplies the focus-side reversal from hiddenness to appearance.
The night-versus-day branch supplies the paired dark interval and makes the focus one pole of an alternation.
The dominant covering branch supplies a layer placed over the field and gives disclosure something concrete to undo.
The non-dominant mapped covering branch independently reinforces concealment as an operation, not merely a dark condition.

structural_cues: 92:1 and 92:2 repeat the oath-noun plus temporal-condition construction while reversing cover and disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored syntax and opposed covering/uncovering images; I infer that the later operation undoes the earlier one. A live alternative is non-causal alternation in which night and day merely succeed each other.

changed_reading.before: Day independently becomes visible.
changed_reading.after: Day manifests by actively reversing a cover, so disclosure carries the remembered pressure of what had enclosed the field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created male-female pair recasts night and day as differentiated complements within an intentionally measured order. The focus event is not simply victory over night; manifestation is one phase becoming distinct within a productive pair.

activation_trace.role: The daylight-opposed-to-night branch supplies one member of the temporal pair.
The manifestation branch makes differentiation perceptible as one member emerges distinctly.
The measuring-and-proportioning branch supplies ordered differentiation and functions as the pair's formative logic.
The bringing-into-being branch supplies generativity and makes the paired order produced rather than accidental.
The male member branch supplies one explicitly differentiated pole of the created pair.
The female member branch supplies the complementary pole and keeps difference from collapsing into solitary dominance.

structural_cues: The first three ayat form parallel oath units, with two temporal operations followed by an explicitly created pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent contrasts and a creation/proportion branch; I infer that the third contrast redescribes the first two as generative differentiation. The live alternative is that the pairs are merely separate oath objects.

changed_reading.before: Day's disclosure defeats or replaces night.
changed_reading.after: Day's disclosure individuates one phase of a created complementary order; opposition remains, but it is also productive pairing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disclosed day becomes a diagnostic field in which motions separate. Directed striving and the non-dominant image of aimless going coexist, while dispersion gives those motions visible distance from one another.

activation_trace.role: The widening branch supplies an open field broad enough for trajectories to separate.
The disclosure branch makes divergent motions legible rather than leaving them latent.
The purposeful-motion branch supplies directed trajectories toward sought ends.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies ungoverned going as a live counter-trajectory to purposeful striving.
The dispersion branch supplies separation as the result visible in the opened field.
The distance-between-things branch turns qualitative difference into a spatially widening gap.

structural_cues: The assertion about divergent striving follows the three oath scenes and can function as what their contrasts illuminate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opened focus field, purposeful and aimless motion branches, and dispersion; I infer that disclosure reveals trajectories by letting their separation develop. The alternative is that daylight only witnesses an already fixed difference.

changed_reading.before: Day manifests uniformly over everything.
changed_reading.after: Day manifests as a differentiating field: under its openness, purposeful and drifting motions disclose how far apart they lead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's opening and clearing becomes a two-channel process. Giving, self-protection, enacted truth, and the good align with an opening into ease; withholding, claimed self-sufficiency, denial, and crooked resistance align with a channel that becomes difficult even while one is being conducted into it.

activation_trace.role: The widening-until-flow branch supplies the channel geometry through which conduct can become progressively easier or more obstructed.
The clearing branch supplies reduced impedance and functions as the perceptual analogue of facilitation.
The handing-over branch supplies outward transfer and initiates the open, circulating path.
The self-in-protection branch supplies a boundary that preserves the traveler without stopping movement.
The stable-completion branch supplies structural soundness and keeps the easier channel from being mere convenience.
The good-versus-ugly branch supplies the valued attractor toward which the open path is oriented.
The opening-after-difficulty branch supplies facilitation as an unfolding process, not just a destination label.
The withholding branch supplies arrested outward flow and begins the constricted counter-channel.
The claimed-independence branch supplies closure to need and relation, reinforcing the blocked path.
The truth-opposition branch supplies refusal of what disclosure makes available and turns perceptual clearing into ethical resistance.
The repeated facilitation branch supplies the paradox that even movement toward hardship can be made progressively self-reinforcing.
The crookedness-and-obstruction branch supplies the geometry of a path that resists straight passage.

structural_cues: 92:5-10 forms two parallel conditional sequences whose repeated facilitation verb leads to opposed endpoints.
The same good object is affirmed in 92:6 and denied in 92:9, making disclosure and refusal hinge on one shared referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired conduct sequences, opening/obstruction images, and repeated facilitation; I infer feedback in which conduct helps form the channel it then travels. A live alternative is external assignment to two routes without self-reinforcement.

changed_reading.before: Daylight neutrally reveals two kinds of conduct.
changed_reading.after: The focus's opening becomes a model of path formation: disclosure shows conduct widening into ease or curling into resistance, with each route becoming easier to continue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hydraulic corridor acquires a terminal gradient. Accumulated means cannot make the traveler self-sufficient when the channel tips toward a fall; manifestation exposes not only a route but where its slope carries what enters it.

activation_trace.role: The flowing river-course branch supplies directed movement whose endpoint depends on gradient.
The disclosure branch makes the otherwise hidden direction and destination of the flow visible.
The sufficiency branch supplies the expected protective capacity that the sentence explicitly negates.
The wealth-accumulation branch supplies stored means that prove unable to arrest the movement.
The falling-to-destruction branch supplies the channel's downward terminus and turns flow into descent.

structural_cues: The temporal condition in 92:11 echoes the focus's temporal condition, pairing manifestation with the threshold of falling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, failed sufficiency, stored wealth, and falling; I infer a slope connecting route to outcome. The alternative is a non-spatial statement that possessions simply fail at a later event.

changed_reading.before: The opened day-channel is inherently liberating.
changed_reading.after: An opened channel also reveals gradient: motion can be smoothly conducted toward a fall that stored wealth cannot dam.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance and the first-last span turn the manifested day into oriented time. Its opening has a beginning, a direction, and an outcome; yet the non-dominant guidance branch keeps open the epistemic risk that an apparent direction can be mentally projected.

activation_trace.role: The dawn-to-sunset interval branch supplies a finite temporal span capable of bearing direction.
The disclosure branch makes direction and outcome readable within the temporal span.
The gentle-direction branch supplies a route toward truth and functions as the positive orientation of disclosed time.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies imagined projection and preserves uncertainty about whether every seeming clarity is genuine guidance.
The later-after-earlier branch supplies a terminal pole for the oriented interval.
The beginning-and-precedence branch supplies the initial pole from which the interval unfolds.
The return-to-outcome branch folds beginning toward consequence and makes temporal disclosure teleological.
The non-dominant succession branch supplies phase following phase and makes the day a sequence rather than a frozen state.

structural_cues: 92:12 assigns guidance, and 92:13 immediately spans the later and the first, placing direction inside total temporal ownership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, sequence, beginning, and outcome; I infer that the day image models oriented time. The non-dominant projection branch leaves live the alternative that apparent manifestness can be mistaken for guidance.

changed_reading.before: Day manifests at one bright instant.
changed_reading.after: Day manifests as an oriented temporal arc whose phases disclose direction from beginning toward outcome, while clarity still requires discernment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later fire sequence prevents brightness from being treated as automatically gentle. Light can disclose by heat, warning, and exposure; the same perceptual opening that clarifies may become unbearable to the one who meets it.

activation_trace.role: The daylight branch supplies brightness as the shared material capable of being either clarifying or severe.
The clear-day branch supplies whitened openness and links manifestation directly to an exposed sky.
The fear-awakening warning branch supplies a communicative function for severe disclosure.
The illumination branch supplies continuity between daylight visibility and fiery visibility.
The kindled-fire branch changes the shared light from a neutral medium into an active source of heat.
The pure-blazing-flame branch intensifies exposure into contact with concentrated heat.
The dominant fire-contact branch supplies the receiver's bodily encounter with disclosed heat.
The non-dominant mapped fire-contact branch independently reinforces encounter rather than distant observation.
The severity-and-suffering branch supplies the affective cost of a disclosure that cannot be comfortably received.

structural_cues: The warning introduces fire through vocabulary that also carries illumination, creating a material overlap with the focus's daylight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies daylight, illumination, flame, warning, and contact with heat; I infer that manifestness can expose and sear rather than merely comfort. The alternative is that daylight and fire are separate light scenes with no transfer of function.

changed_reading.before: The manifest day is benign clarity.
changed_reading.after: The manifest day also prefigures severe exposure: light can warn, strip shelter, and become painful to meet.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's implied gaze becomes an encounter with possible orientations. One can face what manifests, turn the face away, or be conducted to the side and protected from a harmful exposure.

activation_trace.role: The searching-gaze branch supplies the perceiver whose orientation becomes ethically consequential.
The disclosure branch supplies the presented reality toward or away from which the gaze can turn.
The imputing-falsehood branch supplies an active rejection of what the disclosure presents.
The face-turning-toward branch supplies the positive orientation latent inside the same relational root.
The turning-away branch supplies refusal as a spatial reversal of the gaze.
The distancing-to-the-side branch supplies protective separation from the harmful field.
The leading-to-the-side branch supplies an external agentive redirection rather than mere self-withdrawal.
The harm-deflecting branch supplies the purpose of being moved aside and distinguishes protection from denial.

structural_cues: 92:16 and 92:17 juxtapose self-initiated turning away with passive being moved aside, yielding opposed kinds of avoidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gaze, rejection, face-turning, lateral removal, and protection; I infer a relational scene around manifestation. The alternative is that the focus contains no implied observer and these are only later moral actions.

changed_reading.before: Day appears whether or not anyone responds.
changed_reading.after: Manifestation opens an encounter: turning away from disclosed reality and being protectively turned aside are visibly different orientations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's river-channel image is activated by giving, a branch that explicitly channels water, and growth. Wealth ceases to be a static possession and becomes a current whose outward passage opens space for purification and increase.

activation_trace.role: The river-course branch supplies abundant outward flow as the material model for transferred wealth.
The widening-through-flow branch supplies the paradox that release enlarges the channel rather than depleting it.
The manifestation branch makes the internal effect of circulation visible as a changed state.
The giving branch supplies the explicit outward transfer that starts circulation.
The water-channeling branch supplies a concrete conduit and directly activates the focus's river-course potential.
The incoming flood branch supplies movement across social boundaries and keeps the current from being privately enclosed.
The accumulated-wealth branch supplies what is released into the channel.
The growth-and-increase branch supplies the generative result of circulation.
The purification branch supplies inward clearing as the simultaneous result of outward transfer.

structural_cues: 92:18 places giving, wealth, and self-purification in one clause, allowing transfer and inner change to be read as one process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus river, a context water-channel branch, giving, wealth, growth, and purification; I infer that outward circulation enables inward enlargement. The alternative is a non-material moral sequence with no hydraulic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The manifested day is an external river of light.
changed_reading.after: Its river becomes a model of giving: what is released moves through a widened channel and returns as visible purification and growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifestation stretches from an instant into maturation. Growth advances toward ripeness, nurture carries it toward completion, and acceptance names the condition reached; the day is the interval in which a latent state becomes ready to appear.

activation_trace.role: The full daylight interval supplies duration for a state to develop rather than flash into existence.
The repeated polishing branch supplies incremental refinement that culminates in clarity.
The growth branch supplies development from a smaller latent state toward visible increase.
The non-dominant mapped ripeness-for-cutting branch supplies a threshold at which developed potential becomes ready for disclosure.
The nurture-repair-completion branch supplies the sustained agency carrying development toward wholeness.
The non-dominant mapped nourishment-and-growth branch reinforces maturation as a living process rather than an abstract sequence.
The satisfaction-over-agitation branch supplies the settled terminal state of the developmental process.
The non-dominant mapped acceptance branch independently supplies reception of what has reached manifest readiness.

structural_cues: The closing sequence moves from purification through the rejection of repayment and purposeful seeking to eventual satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, ripeness, nurture, completion, and acceptance; I infer a developmental arrow connecting them. A live alternative is that these are separate predicates and that focus manifestation remains instantaneous.

changed_reading.before: Day becomes manifest in a single transition.
changed_reading.after: Day models maturation: a hidden capacity is grown, refined, brought to readiness, and finally received in a settled state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The public-display baseline is stripped of a human exchange audience and redirected. What becomes visible is action facing beyond reciprocal favor toward a highest direction; manifestation is exposure of orientation, completed not by repayment but by acceptance.

activation_trace.role: The opened day supplies the public field in which orientation and motive can become visible.
The searching-gaze branch supplies directed attention and allows manifestation to be read as an orientation test.
The exhaustive-negation branch removes every human counterparty from the motive structure.
The favor-and-good-condition branch supplies the social benefit that might otherwise demand return.
The act-for-recompense branch supplies the reciprocal economy that the clause excludes.
The seeking branch supplies intentional direction after reciprocal motive has been removed.
The direction-and-destination branch supplies the vector toward which disclosed action faces.
The front-of-day branch loops the directional image directly back into the focus's daytime field.
The lordship branch supplies the non-human authority before whom motive is exposed.
The elevation branch supplies vertical priority and redirects the gaze beyond horizontal exchange.
The satisfaction branch supplies acceptance as the endpoint replacing human repayment.

structural_cues: The negated reciprocal clause in 92:19 is followed by an exceptive purpose clause in 92:20 and a future satisfaction clause in 92:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excluded human recompense, seeking, direction, height, lordship, and satisfaction; I infer that manifestation exposes what an act faces. The alternative is that the focus remains cosmological and only later clauses concern motive.

changed_reading.before: The day displays itself to any available observer.
changed_reading.after: The day becomes an image of motive made public: action is disclosed by the direction it faces once human repayment is removed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the day root's speech-act branch rather than its temporal sense. It remains anchored in the word-1 root and the word-3 notoriety branch, while warning, denial, and turning away make public exposure function like rebuke. Render only as an exploratory social-acoustic metaphor, not as a lexical replacement for day.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 day root can carry harsh verbal checking, and the word-3 root can carry open notoriety.

activation_trace.role: The harsh-rebuke branch supplies forceful checking and makes daylight's arrival socially confrontive.
The open-notoriety branch supplies public undeniability and turns rebuke into exposure.
The warning-that-awakens-caution branch supplies the rebuke's intended alerting function.
The imputing-falsehood branch supplies the denial that public manifestness confronts.
The turning-away branch supplies the evasive response against which the rebuking exposure presses.

changed_reading.before: Daylight silently makes things visible.
changed_reading.after: Daylight behaves like a public rebuke: its manifestness checks denial by making evasion conspicuous.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus day noun's bird-chick branch and the manifestation root's ceremonial-display branch are highly form-distant. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains a coherent emergence mechanism from creation, fertility, growth, and nurture. Render as a contained natal or ecological analogy, never as the base denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 root contains a bird-chick image, while the word-3 root contains presentation after prior concealment.

activation_trace.role: The bird-chick branch supplies a newly emerged living form and makes daybreak analogous to hatching.
The ceremonial-presentation branch supplies movement from protected concealment into witnessed presence.
The bringing-into-being branch supplies the generative transition behind emergence.
The fertile-ground branch supplies an ecological matrix in which emergence can be nurtured.
The growth branch supplies development preceding the moment of visible emergence.
The nurture-to-completion branch supplies sustained care carrying the latent form toward display.

changed_reading.before: Daybreak is an inorganic change in ambient light.
changed_reading.after: Daybreak can be carried as a natal image: a nurtured living interval breaks concealment and is presented to view.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a rare sudden-taking branch of the day root. It remains anchored at word 1 and joins the focus uncovering verb to the immediately preceding cover. Render as a kinetic description of abrupt transition, not as a claim that the verse denotes theft.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 root can evoke a sudden or stealthy taking, while word 3 requires the result to remain a manifestation.

activation_trace.role: The sudden-snatch branch supplies abrupt acquisition and makes the transition feel seized rather than gradual.
The uncovering branch constrains the object of the imagined snatch to visibility itself.
The prior cover branch supplies the enclosure from which visibility is suddenly recovered.

changed_reading.before: Day gradually succeeds night.
changed_reading.after: At the threshold of manifestation, day seems to snatch the visible field out from under night's cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines widening, blade-polishing, fire-straightening, and cutting-at-ripeness across material domains. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by explicit fire and cutting branches. Render only as a qualified material analogy for sharpened discrimination, not as an occult object-identification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 root supplies an opening cut or wound-like widening, and the word-3 root supplies polishing of an edge.

activation_trace.role: The cut-and-widen branch supplies an incision-like opening through which visibility spreads.
The blade-polishing branch supplies a sharpened reflective edge and makes disclosure an act of discrimination.
The kindled-fire branch supplies heat as the material condition for tempering the imagined edge.
The fire-straightening branch supplies shaping by heat and turns brightness into a refining operation.
The non-dominant cutting branch supplies the decisive separation made possible by the polished edge.

changed_reading.before: Daylight softly clears indistinction.
changed_reading.after: Daylight can be imagined as a tempered, polished edge that cuts open the field and sharply separates what had blended together.

strongest_changes: The night-cover cue turns manifestation into an active countermotion rather than an isolated bright state.
The paired conduct sequences convert opening and clearing into divergent ease and hardship channels that become progressively traversable.
Guidance and the first-last span stretch manifestation into oriented time with a beginning, succession, and outcome.
Fire revises daylight's apparent benevolence by showing that disclosure can warn, expose, and sear.
Giving, water-channeling, wealth, and growth activate a hydraulic reading in which outward circulation produces inward purification.
The closing sequence redirects public display away from human reciprocity and toward disclosed orientation and acceptance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories already made one short daylight clause simultaneously optical, spatial, hydraulic, social, and expulsive. Context did not collapse those possibilities: it made covering and revealing reciprocal, converted light into path geometry, allowed fire to darken the value of brightness, and gave rare split-root branches real work in projection, circulation, ripening, nurture, and orientation.
remaining_uncertainties: The reflexive manifestation may foreground the day itself, the field it clears, or both; the packet does not force one grammatical object model.
The causal arrows from giving to widening, conduct to self-reinforcing path, and nurture to acceptance are abductive reader moves rather than explicit packet relations.

Non-dominant mapped branches involving aimless motion, imagined projection, cutting, and nourishment preserve valuable surprise but should not be treated as direct morphological glosses of their source forms.
The rebuke, hatching, sudden-snatch, and tempered-edge readings are anchored exploratory analogies and should coexist with, not replace, the stronger opening-disclosure model.
